title: Pasta's Cobblemon Server Experience v1
description: A smaller version of the main modpack containing only the things necessary to run a server for it.
body:
This modpack is now outdated, as it has been replaced by [Pasta's Cobblemon Server Experience v2](https://modrinth.com/modpack/pastas-cobblemon-server-experience-v2). I might patch a few issues if they are issues also present in its successor, but aside from that this version will not be supported anymore.

# DETAILED DESCRIPTION

This is the server version of [Pasta's Cobblemon Experience v1](https://modrinth.com/modpack/pastas-cobblemon-experience-v1). This one trims out the fat by removing mods that doesn't have any serverside functionality or that simply prevents the server from launching when present.

This one could potentially be used instead of the client version of the modpack for singleplayer if you really want to, but I don't see why you would.

Unlike the client version, datapacks won't automatically be applied to a new world when created through a server. I personally recommend just making the world in singleplayer before moving it to your server, but if you can't/don't want to do that then don't forget to copy over the datapacks into your world's datapack folder.

All mods and datapacks in this version is also in the client version, so refer to the client's modpage for a list of all mods included. This also goes for screenshots of the modpack and the credit for the thumbnail, it's all on the main page.
